maxAgents.title: Max Agents
maxAgents.description: The maximum number of agents allowed on this crowd.

maxAgentRadius.title: Max Agent Radius
maxAgentRadius.description: The maximum radius an agent can have.

borderSize.title: Border Size
borderSize.description: The size of the non-navigable border around the heightfield. [Limit: >=0] [Units: vx]

tileSize.title: Tile Size
tileSize.description: The width/height size of tile's on the xz-plane. [Limit: >= 0] [Units: vx]. If tileSize is provided, a tiled navmesh will be created. If tileSize is not provided, or is set to zero, a solo navmesh will be created. To use obstacles, a tiled navmesh must be generated.

cs.title: Cell Size
cs.description: The xz-plane cell size to use for fields. [Limit: > 0] [Units: wu]

ch.title: Cell Height
ch.description: The y-axis cell size to use for fields. [Limit: > 0] [Units: wu]

walkableHeight.title: Walkable Height
walkableHeight.description: Minimum floor to 'ceiling' height that will still allow the floor area to be considered walkable. [Limit: >= 3] [Units: vx]

walkableClimb.title: Walkable Climb
walkableClimb.description: Maximum ledge height that is considered to still be traversable. [Limit: >=0] [Units: vx]

walkableRadius.title: Walkable Radius
walkableRadius.description: The distance to erode/shrink the walkable area of the heightfield away from obstructions. [Limit: >=0] [Units: vx]

maxEdgeLen.title: Max Edge Length
maxEdgeLen.description: The maximum allowed length for contour edges along the border of the mesh. [Limit: >=0] [Units: vx]

maxSimplificationError.title: Max Simplification Error
maxSimplificationError.description: The maximum distance a simplified contour's border edges should deviate the original raw contour. [Limit: >=0] [Units: vx]

minRegionArea.title: Min Region Area
minRegionArea.description: The minimum number of cells allowed to form isolated island areas. [Limit: >=0] [Units: vx]

mergeRegionArea.title: Merge Region Area
mergeRegionArea.description: Any regions with a span count smaller than this value will, if possible, be merged with larger regions. [Limit: >=0] [Units: vx]

maxVertsPerPoly.title: Max Vertices Per Poly
maxVertsPerPoly.description: The maximum number of vertices allowed for polygons generated during the contour. [Limit: >=0] [Units: vx]

detailSampleDist.title: Detail Sample Distance
detailSampleDist.description: Sets the sampling distance to use when generating the detail mesh. (For height detail only.) [Limits: 0 or >= 0.9] [Units: wu]

detailSampleMaxError.title: Detail Sample Max Error
detailSampleMaxError.description: The maximum distance the detail mesh surface should deviate from heightfield data. (For height detail only.) [Limit: >=0] [Units: wu]

debugNavMesh.title: Debug Nav Mesh
debugNavMesh.description: If enabled the generated nav mesh will be rendered.

queryExtent.title: Query Extent
queryExtent.description: Set the Bounding box extent for doing spatial queries.

excludeTags.title: Exclude Tags
excludeTags.description: Model entities with one of the listed tags will be excluded from the navmesh generation.

onEventStart.title: On Event Start
onEventStart.description: Run the navmesh generator when this app wide event fires, if empty the navmesh will be generated on entity initialize.

onEventReady.title: On Event Ready
onEventReady.description: Fire a custom event when the navmesh generation has finished.

walkableSlopeAngle.title: Walkable Slope Angle
walkableSlopeAngle.description: The maximum slope that is considered walkable. [Limits: 0 <= value < 90] [Units: Degrees]

template.title: Template
template.description: Reference a template asset to automatically instantiate on initialize.

customShape.title: Custom Shape
customShape.description: Select if a custom shape type will be created.

groupByScale.title: Group By Scale
groupByScale.description: Extends the default trimesh collider to support model scaling. Models should have a uniform scale and vary their scale from to another based on the step provided. This settings works only for trimesh shapes. If 0.0 is provided the regular PlayCanvas engine cache will be used instead.

collisionQueryRange.title: Collision Query Range
collisionQueryRange.description: Defines how close a collision element must be before it is considered for steering behaviors. [Limits: > 0]

separationWeight.title: Separation Weight
separationWeight.description: How aggressive the agent manager should be at avoiding collisions with this agent. [Limit: >= 0]

obstacleAvoidanceType.title: Obstacle Avoidance Type
obstacleAvoidanceType.description: The index of the avoidance configuration to use for the agent. [Limits: 0 <= value <= #DT_CROWD_MAX_OBSTAVOIDANCE_PARAMS]

queryFilterType.title: Query Filter Type
queryFilterType.description: The index of the query filter used by this agent.

stopDistance.title: Stop Distance
stopDistance.description: The distance from the path end point this agent should stop at. If 0.0 is provided the agent will reach as close as possible to the end point.

crowdEntity.title: Crowd Entity
crowdEntity.description: The crowd entity this agent should belong to.

debugLine.title: Debug Line
debugLine.description: If enabled a debug line will be rendered with the active path.

debugLineColor.title: Debug Line Color
debugLineColor.description: The color of the debug line rendered.

schema.name: title
schema.title: Title
schema.description: The title of the preset shown in the dialog.

schema.name: resolution
schema.title: Resolution
schema.description: This defines how much the resolution will be downscaled or upscaled in relation to the viewport resolution. Leverage the browser bilinear filtering to increase performance by rendering your application in a lower resolution. Or render to a higher resolution for reducing anti alias.

schema.name: devicePixelRatio
schema.title: Device Pixel Ratio
schema.description: A normalized value 0-1 to indicate min/max device pixel ratio.

schema.name: fogNoise
schema.title: Fog Noise
schema.description: Requires page reload.

schema.name: grass
schema.title: Grass
schema.description: Requires page reload.

startEntity.title: Start Entity
startEntity.description: If an entity is provided a start button will be created to enable that entity on user's action. The lobby entity will be disabled at the same time.

lobbyEntity.title: Lobby Entity
lobbyEntity.description: If an entity is provided the lobby entity will be enabled as soon as the settings dialog is enabled.

grassObjects.title: Grass Objects
grassObjects.description: A list of entities to be disabled if grass is disabled in settings.

minTerrainLod.title: Min Terrain Lod
minTerrainLod.description: The minimum terrain LOD when no shadows are cast from the terain.

terrainEntities.title: Terrain Entities
terrainEntities.description: If one or more terrain entities are provided, they will be binded to the terrain shadows toggle.

autoSelectPreset.title: Auto Select Preset
autoSelectPreset.description: If selected a graphics preset will automatically be selected based on the device platform.

playerControllers.title: Player Controllers
playerControllers.description: One or more player controllers to be used with the Toggle Controller button.

defaultController.title: Default Controller
defaultController.description: The default controller the game will start with.

resolution.title: Resolution
resolution.description: This defines how much the resolution will be downscaled or upscaled in relation to the viewport resolution. Leverage the browser bilinear filtering to increase performance by rendering your application in a lower resolution. Or render to a higher resolution for reducing anti alias.

navMeshEntity.title: Nav Mesh Entity
navMeshEntity.description: Drag and drop the pathfinder entity this crowd should interact with. Updating this requires regenerating the navmesh or reloading your app

extents.title: Extents
extents.description: The box extents on each axis.

angleY.title: Angle Y
angleY.description: The angle of the box orientation on the Y axis.

state.title: State
state.description: The state of the obstacle, if it's enabled and blocking or not.

hideChildren.title: Hide Children
hideChildren.description: If selected the children of this entity will automatically be disabled when the obstacle state is false.
